items.text: open a round-video camera preview and start recording only when you tap record
adjust round-video zoom below the preview, with lens stops on compatible rear cameras and a continuous scale elsewhere
preview attached photos and videos as an album or a strip, with a compact header, grouping and file controls

items.text: pasted media, keyboard images and single-chat shares wait above the field; scheduled messages, quick replies and paid chats use the dock too

items.text: scripts can run on a schedule, switch day and night mode and add their own settings pages
scripts can clean or replace opened links, silence notifications and reject files shared into the app, with your permission
scripts can expand text in the message field, follow the player and calls, and add actions to message menus
script logs support selection across entries and precise timestamps; installed scripts share one settings group
mixed attached files and media keep their order and one caption; cancelling scheduling or payment keeps the tray
network requests and message decorators no longer block script timers or message rendering
local script translations stay out of the message editor; editing the message or stopping its script clears stale decorations
scripting stays enabled after a restart, profile changes refresh on screen and optional request fields reach Telegram
scripts cannot read another account's notifications or answer another script's pending interceptor requests
importing, replacing or changing a script revokes its old permissions; the first update to this build resets script permissions and script storage
streamer mode blocks capture of disappearing media even when screenshots are otherwise allowed
peeking at last seen restores every privacy exception, and local-password recovery checks the account that owns the lock
a legacy local password must be entered once before recovery can be attached to its owner
signing out clears the account's locally kept deleted messages, saved drafts and script state so another login cannot inherit them
the Other changes section keeps its notes inside one card, and long translated script-import notices wrap in full
hidden-word patterns, server images and update filenames are bounded to protect responsiveness, memory and local files
freeze reports count only foreground stalls while the phone is awake; background time and sleep no longer trigger them
